major_cooldowns.name: Summon Infernal
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Destruction's main cooldown: send it on cooldown and stack your potion, on-use trinkets and racials inside the 30 sec window, since Crashing Chaos empowers your next 8 spenders and Rain of Chaos only rolls while the initial Infernal is out.

major_cooldowns.name: Cataclysm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: In multitarget cast it on cooldown, delaying a few seconds only when that catches more targets; in pure single target it is not a damage gain, so hold it as a cheap refresh for Immolate or Wither as they expire.

major_cooldowns.name: Soul Fire
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it at the pull and then take it on cooldown whenever you are below 4 Soul Shards, so its 10 fragments and the free Immolate application both land.

major_cooldowns.name: Havoc
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Mark the secondary target with several Soul Shards and Conflagrate charges already banked, then dump Chaos Bolt into the 15 sec window; hold it when you know an add lands within 10 sec, and otherwise press it whenever a second target is up and Summon Infernal is not about to come off cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Malevolence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hellcaller's damage window: press it with as many targets carrying Wither as possible and spend Shadowburn and Chaos Bolt inside the 20 sec buff.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Ability table lists 430014 as a name-verified Hellcaller id not observed in the sampled Diabolist parse and carries no base cooldown; the 60s value and the cast id both need a Wowhead check against a Hellcaller log.

defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Pre-press it for a known raid hit: 25% damage reduction plus immunity to interrupt, silence and pushback keeps your casts rolling straight through the damage.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Shield before the hit lands, while you are still healthy: it spends 20% of current health to absorb 200% of it, so it is worth the least when you are already low.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Heals 20% of maximum health and horrifies the target for 3 sec, so use it as a routine top-up on any nearby enemy rather than saving it.

rules.description: Immolate never falls off the target
rules.action: Keep Immolate on the target at all times; it is your passive shard generation. Refresh inside the last 5.4 sec of the dot, or 6.3 sec with Scalding Flames, so the pandemic window rolls the remainder into the new one.

rules.description: Soul Fire and Cataclysm before Infernal and Chaos Bolt
rules.action: Pre-cast Soul Fire and Cataclysm, apply your dot, then Conflagrate into Summon Infernal, fire trinkets and racials with it, and spend the banked shards on Chaos Bolt.

rules.description: Soul Fire only below 4 Soul Shards
rules.action: Only take Soul Fire while you are below 4 Soul Shards. It hands back 10 fragments, so pressing it near the 5 shard cap throws a full shard away.

rules.description: Shadowburn on every Fiendish Cruelty proc
rules.action: Fire Shadowburn as soon as Fiendish Cruelty procs. The cast costs no Soul Shards and ignores the 20% health requirement, and the proc only holds for 30 sec.

rules.description: Ruination spent before the buff expires
rules.action: Cast Ruination as soon as a Pit Lord grants it. It replaces your next Chaos Bolt for far more damage, so send it ahead of any other spender.

rules.description: Shadowburn as the spender up to 6 targets
rules.action: Shadowburn stays your best spender up to 6 targets with Conflagration of Chaos, 5 once Destructive Rapidity is also talented, and 3 without Conflagration of Chaos. Fiendish Cruelty adds one target to each count on Diabolist. Above the cutoff, sink shards into Rain of Fire instead.

source_summary: Destruction generates Soul Shards with Incinerate and Conflagrate and dumps them into Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn, so the cooldown plan is built around Summon Infernal: send it on cooldown and stack potion, trinkets and racials inside its 30 sec window. Cataclysm is treated as a mass Immolate applicator rather than burst, used on cooldown in multitarget and held for dot refreshes in single target, while Havoc is banked with shards and Conflagrate charges for an incoming add. Hellcaller adds Malevolence as a second window to spend into, and Diabolist turns spender casts into Diabolic Ritual procs that pay out Ruination.
